description: Deterministic romanisation of any script to plain ASCII (Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, Devanagari, Thai, Arabic…) for slugs, sorting, matching and systems that reject non-ASCII. Not an official spelling: for Arabic names the result is a consonant skeleton and is flagged low confidence. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.
